title: Heavy Core Chance Config
description: Makes Heavy Core drop chance configurable through a config file.
body:
# HeavyCoreChance **HeavyCoreChance** lets server owners configure the drop chance of the **Heavy Core** from Ominous Vaults in Trial Chambers. The Heavy Core has a ~7.5% chance to drop by default — making the Mace one of the most frustrating items to obtain in vanilla survival. With this plugin you can adjust that to whatever suits your server, without touching a single loot table or data pack. --- [](https://discord.gg/7Sa9VmmWZX) [](https://ko-fi.com/justbuddy) --- # Support If you find any bugs or have any suggestions join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/Pjm9GFuSyG). --- ## Features - Set the Heavy Core drop chance to **any value from 0% to 100%** - Defaults to **7.5%** — the exact vanilla rate — so nothing changes until you want it to - Reload the config live with `/hcc reload`, **no restart required** - All other Ominous Vault loot is **completely untouched** --- ## Config ```yaml # plugins/HeavyCoreChance/config.yml # 0.0 = Heavy Core never drops # 7.5 = Vanilla default (~1 in 13 vaults) # 100.0 = Heavy Core always drops heavy-core-drop-chance: 7.5 ``` --- ## Commands & Permissions | Command | Permission | Default | |---|---|---| | `/hcc reload` | `heavycorechance.reload` | OP only | --- ## Requirements | | | |---|---| | **Server software** | [PaperMC](https://papermc.io) | | **Java version** | 1.21.x | ---
